column1: # Every metric family the Python api registers (prometheus_client REGISTRY
# after importing dev_health_ops.api.main), with its Go status. The counter
# parity oracle lists the live families and fails on any family missing
# here, any row whose family Python no longer registers, and any "ported"
# row the oracle does not drive (routeCounters).
#   ported  = the Go api exposes it and the oracle compares it with Python
#   runtime = a process/interpreter collector, not a route counter
#   pending = not yet classified or ported (the route-counter inventory)
